description: Defines the QuicBatchWriterBuffer class, which manages an internal buffer for batching packet data in QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer for batching multiple packet writes, supporting push, pop, and buffer management operations.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all buffered writes, keeping the internal buffer intact.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next writable location in the buffer.

methods.name: PushBufferedWrite
methods.description: Adds a new buffered write to the internal buffer.

methods.name: PopBufferedWrite
methods.description: Removes a specified number of buffered writes from the front.

methods.name: buffered_writes
methods.description: Returns the deque of buffered writes.

methods.name: SizeInUse
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes currently used in the buffer.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer state for debugging.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: Checks internal buffer invariants for debugging.
